evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.

The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
"I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
"These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.
